news.title: Zambia thrash Portugal to win FIFA U-15 World Cup Tier B title
news.lede: Zambia’s Under-15 national team produced an impressive performance to beat Portugal 5-2 and clinch the Tier B title at the inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival in Baku, Azerbaijan. Maxen Msimuko led the charge with a hat-trick, while Benson and Thomson also found the net as the Junior Chipolopolo capped their campaign with a convincing victory over their European opponents. Samuel Musonda also came close to getting on the scoresheet, striking the crossbar as Zambia dominated the contest to secure the title. The triumph marks a significant achievement for the young Zambian side, who competed against teams from across the world at the landmark youth football festival.

news.title: This National Team qualified for the World Cup. Now they are fundraising to get there.
news.lede: Men’s National Team, managed by the American Amputee Soccer Association, punched its ticket to the Amputee Soccer World Cup this fall. news.title: Bermuda close out Under-15 World Cup on a winning note
news.lede: Bermuda concluded their participation at the Fifa Under-15 World Cup & Festival in Baku, Azerbaijan, on a high with a 2-0 triumph over Jordan in a Tier D finals match today. Adam Barritt and co-captain De’Ari Trott scored for Aaron Denkins's side to end the tournament on a bright note. It was Bermuda’s third victory in the knockout and placement stage, following wins over Macao and Bahrain. From ten matches played in the whole tournament, Bermuda finished with five wins and the same number of defeats to place 117th of 189.

news.title: Players who defined an entire World Cup
news.lede: The World Cup has never felt like just another football competition. Every four years, it seems to produce players who step out of the ordinary and leave something lasting behind. It is not always the top scorer or even the captain of the winning side who stands out, but often the one who carries their team through the pressure and expectation. Some moments are defined by brilliance, others by controversy, yet certain players shape the entire feel of a tournament.
